title: API database password typo
alert: The shop homepage loads, but any action needing the API (products, cart, checkout) shows 'Service unavailable'. The API health endpoint returns 503.

truth.root_cause: The api 2.3.2 deploy introduced a typo in the DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable, so the application cannot authenticate to PostgreSQL. Every database connection fails with a password error.
truth.fix: Roll back the api container to image shopapp/api:2.3.1, then verify the health endpoint returns 200 and product pages work again.
